messages.author: Grant Tuhiwai
messages.body: Reminder field day at the Kerrisons on the 19th, 10am start, bring your own lunch they're doing tea and scones. Topic is pasture renewal and whatever else comes up

messages.author: Shaun Kerrison
messages.body: Yep all good this end. Park along the race not on the lawn pls Jo will have my guts

messages.author: Mikaela Dunn
messages.body: Bit of a random one but @Bev you guys went 10 in 7 this season didn't you? We're thinking about it for after Christmas, Tom's knees are stuffed and the young fella we've got is already talking about leaving because of the hours. What's the hit on production been honestly? And did the cells go mental? Our vet says try it, the Fonterra rep basically said don't. Would love the real version not the brochure lol. No rush

messages.author: Grant Tuhiwai
messages.body: Good question, keen to hear too. We looked at it 2 yrs ago and chickened out
